metadata.limitations: ADAN full-assembly changes are small and vary with unchanged controls. Network residual/Jacobian gains are clear in all20 pairs. Untouched cell-Jacobian code generation changes during recompilation; timings characterize each complete resulting binary. Scope timers contain rounded reporting-rank diagnostics, and RCR-loop savings are included only in full assembly timers. Derivative-cache timings remain controls. All original pairs and cases are retained.

scope_timer_evidence.scope_limit: Rounded TimerOutput reporting-rank diagnostics, normalized by displayed call count; not independent MPI maximum measurements. No derivative-cache gain claimed.
